The '''Censorate''' is one of Huanglong's three judicial bodies. It holds the authority to jointly try major cases and wields significant supervisory power, a duty summarized as "to probe evil and maintain discipline." Its officials are generally titled Censors, while those stationed or assigned temporarily in the six cities are called Investigating Censors.
